en_how: A cork texture is built once from fractal noise and speckle; cards are pinned on one at a time with a small drop and bounce, and each red string only pulls from pin to pin once both its cards are up; the camera just pans and pushes in by moving and scaling the whole board with t, a desk-lamp radial gradient crushes the edges, and at 3.8 s a camera flash whites out the frame to reveal the suspect and stamp the case closed.
